recognize_zh: A 圖抹片可見數顆大型不典型淋巴球（深藍細胞質、核大）與一顆碎裂細胞，紅血球有聚集成團的傾向；B 圖骨髓切片細胞密度高、被大片瀰漫性單核細胞浸潤取代，符合 DLBCL 侵犯骨髓，並可解釋伴隨的冷凝集素溶血。
features: Smear: large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, high N:C ratio and irregular nuclei (panel A)
Occasional smudged/degenerating cell and small lymphocytes
Red cells in irregular small clumps suggestive of agglutination, with polychromasia
Biopsy: markedly hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheet-like infiltrate replacing normal hematopoiesis (panel B)
Residual fat spaces and a bony trabecula; cytologic detail of the infiltrate limited at this magnification
describe_en: Smear shows several large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and irregular nuclei, admixed with small lymphocytes and a smudged cell. Red cells show irregular clumping suggestive of agglutination. The bone marrow trephine biopsy is markedly hypercellular with a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate that largely replaces normal hematopoiesis; high-power cytology and immunophenotype are not shown. In an HIV-positive patient with cold agglutinin hemolysis and a monoclonal gammopathy, findings are consistent with marrow and blood involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, pending immunohistochemical confirmation.

ddx.dx: Reactive viral lymphocytosis (e.g. EBV, acute HIV)
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous and polyclonal and do not produce diffuse marrow replacement, which requires B-cell marker and clonality studies to confirm lymphoma.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with vacuolated deeply basophilic cytoplasm, a starry-sky biopsy pattern and MYC rearrangement with Ki-67 near 100%.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: Plasmablastic cells have eccentric nuclei with a Golgi hof and are CD20-negative, CD138/MUM1-positive, often EBER-positive in HIV.
Blasts have fine chromatin with scant cytoplasm and express CD34/TdT or myeloid markers, unlike mature B-cell lymphoma cells.
